description: This file defines a React custom hook useScaleToFit, which applies responsive scaling transformations to a container element for Figma design previews, considering device pixel ratio and viewport size. It includes utility functions for debouncing resize events and snapping scale to device pixels, managing event listeners and observers for dynamic viewport changes.

methods.name: debounce(fn, wait = 50)
methods.description: Limits the frequency of function calls, used to optimize resize and orientation change handling.

methods.name: snapScaleToDPR(scale)
methods.description: Adjusts a scale value to align with device pixel ratio, reducing blurriness on transforms.

methods.name: useScaleToFit( containerRef, { designWidth, designHeight, dprSnap = true, centerHorizontally = true, observeDocument = true, } = {} )
methods.description: Main hook that applies a DPR-aware scale transform to a container ref, responding to viewport resize and layout changes.

ctags.name: useScaleToFit
ctags.signature: ( containerRef, { designWidth, designHeight, dprSnap = true, centerHorizontally = true, observeDocument = true, } = {} )
